review.use_summary: Used Nextflow21.04.1 to orchestrate nf-core/eager2.4.4 for ancient-DNA read processing, human-read removal and HOPS assessment of MALT output. The described pipeline includes adapter/quality trimming, mapping, MAPQ filtering, duplicate removal and damage profiling.
review.implementation_scope_note: The engine21.04.1 and pipeline2.4.4 are distinct; trailing citation numbers are not patch digits. Exact databases, libraries and component software/settings remain required. JUC013 used a separate computational approach; the low RAZ007 genus counts did not support HOPS assessment.

review.use_summary: Wrapped per-library scRNA-seq preprocessing in a two-process Nextflow pipeline and per-sample scATAC-seq analyses in another Nextflow script for parallelization and reproducibility. A separate ISS pipeline performs projection/stitching, optical-flow registration, CellPose segmentation and PoSTcode decoding into expression matrices.
review.implementation_scope_note: The Nextflow edition and complete workflow commands are unstated. scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq and ISS pipelines are distinct; orchestrator support alone does not implement or validate their biological/image-analysis components.

review.use_summary: Used the Nextflow distiller-nf pipeline for mm9 Micro-C alignment and processing, with make_pairsam=False, drop_readid=False, --add-columns mapq --walks-policy mask and max_mismatch_bp=1. Produced balanced multi-resolution cooler files at the listed100bp–10Mb resolutions; merged15U/20U libraries with pairtools.
review.implementation_scope_note: Nextflow and distiller-nf editions are unstated. Exact workflow/configuration and dependencies must be supplied. FitHiChIP subsequently consumes the mcool output with its separately reported peak, distance, interaction and bias settings; those are not Nextflow engine parameters.

review.use_summary: Used the distiller Nextflow pipeline to align Hi-C/HiChIP reads to mm10, retain uniquely mapped reads with MAPQ>30 and remove duplicates, then bin contacts with cooler. The source lists Java8, Nextflow and Docker requirements and pools two to three replicates after individual-replicate comparison.
review.implementation_scope_note: The engine and pipeline releases are unstated. The Java8 requirement is historical source context, not a license to substitute a modern engine silently. Docker, genomic inputs and downstream cooler processing remain separate dependencies.

review.use_summary: Used Nextflow24.04.4 with nf-core/rnasplice1.0.4 to orchestrate FastQC0.12.1, TrimGalore0.6.7, STAR2.7.9a and rMATS4.1.2 against C.elegans WBcel235/ce11. Differential splicing uses absolute delta-PSI>=0.05 and P<0.05, followed by boxplots.
review.implementation_scope_note: Engine24.04.4, pipeline1.0.4 and component versions are distinct. Exact workflow, genome/annotation and sample configuration must be supplied. Running the engine does not establish that this complete RNA/splicing pipeline or its biological conclusions were reproduced.

review.use_summary: Used a bespoke Nextflow DuplexPipe workflow for duplex FASTQ processing with fgbio2.2.1, UMI extraction using FastqToBam and bwa-mem0.7.17 alignment. The reference is GRCh38 GCA_000001405.15 without alternate contigs and with a U2FA1 mapping patch.
review.implementation_scope_note: The Nextflow release and exact workflow commit/commands are unstated. Preserve the source reference patch and complete UMI/duplex processing definitions; generic orchestrator execution does not recreate them.

review.implementation_scope_note: The engine edition and exact workflow commit/parameters are unstated in this description. These four HLA-analysis components and required allele/reference resources remain distinct from execution-engine support.

review.use_summary: Scripted single-molecule-footprinting preprocessing in Nextflow22.10.6. The source separately describes R4.2.2/RStudio analysis and high-performance computing through SLURM using direct Bash or rslurm.
review.implementation_scope_note: Do not infer a Nextflow SLURM executor setting from the broader HPC statement. Exact SMF workflow code, dependencies and inputs must be supplied; engine22.10.6 is distinct from the reported R and RStudio editions.
